integrity: Analytical proof with exact Jacobi recurrence and beta-moment bounds; standalone finite checker is corroborative, not an infinite proof; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Real C^3 radial squared-radius symbols on full bianalytic weighted disk Bergman spaces only; cancellation W=0 gives an upper bound but no sharp secondary exponent; incomplete historical-priority access for one 2025 algebraic commutativity article.
title: Cubic singular-value law for radial Toeplitz commutators on bianalytic Bergman spaces
